Card Q&A.q: This card’s effect reveals 2 copies of the same card with [Huckmon], [Jesmon], or [Sistermon] in their names from the top of my deck. Can I add both copies to my hand?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Add up to 2 Digimon cards with [Huckmon], [Jesmon], or [Sistermon] in their names among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
